_comment: English convenience translation of the planted inconsistencies in example 1. It was not used in the study; wording, count, and severity can vary by model.

planted_inconsistencies.description: Admission date is after the discharge date
planted_inconsistencies.note: Admission is 15 March 2024 and discharge is 10 March 2024, so the stay ends before it begins.

planted_inconsistencies.description: CRP is described as decreasing to a higher value
planted_inconsistencies.note: A change from 180 mg/L to 210 mg/L is an increase, not a decrease.

planted_inconsistencies.description: Antibiotic prescribed despite a documented penicillin allergy
planted_inconsistencies.note: A penicillin allergy is documented, but amoxicillin, a penicillin, is prescribed.
Levothyroxine is dosed in micrograms; 50 mg would be a 1,000-fold overdose.
The patient is introduced as Mr Max Mustermann, but later referred to as she.
The appointment is 05 March 2024 and discharge is 10 March 2024, placing follow-up in the past.
